configurePresets.name: web
configurePresets.description: Builds house3d_demo as a self-contained HTML page via Emscripten. Requires EMSDK to be active (source emsdk_env.sh). Run with: emcmake cmake --preset web

configurePresets.name: devices-asan
configurePresets.description: Debug + EASYGL + tests, instrumented with AddressSanitizer. Verified working in plan_devices_phase8.md Task P8-4 — detects use-after-free/heap-corruption bugs (e.g. the Task P8-1 self-destroy-during-callback fix). Does not detect data races; use devices-tsan for that.

configurePresets.name: devices-tsan
configurePresets.description: Debug + EASYGL + tests, instrumented with ThreadSanitizer. Verified working in plan_devices_phase8.md Task P8-4 — the tool that actually detects data races (ASan does not). As of Task P8-2, running the Devices-only test suite under this preset reports exactly one pre-existing, unrelated race in sharp-runtime's TimeSpan copy constructor (a debug copy_count counter) — out of scope for Microsoft::Devices work; any *new* race reported here is worth investigating.

configurePresets.name: devices-ubsan
configurePresets.description: Debug + EASYGL + tests, instrumented with UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer. Verified working in plan_devices_phase8.md Task P8-4 — the full Devices-only suite reports zero issues under this preset.
